name: Gordon Ritter
current_role: Founder & General Partner, Emergence Capital; Chairman of the Board, Veeva Systems
profile: San Francisco enterprise-software VC who founded Emergence Capital. He led Emergence's first major investment in Salesforce and backed Veeva Systems in 2008 when it had ~25 employees; he has chaired Veeva's board since, and his Veeva stake underpins his wealth. Earlier he founded Whistle Communications (acquired by IBM).
interesting_fact: He co-founded Software As Service with Marc Benioff, which became the foundation for the Salesforce Platform; Veeva later became the first public company to convert to a Public Benefit Corporation under his chairmanship.
deep_cut_fact: A former Princeton rower, he has summited Denali and run across Switzerland; after IBM bought his startup Whistle Communications he led IBM's $3B Global Small Business division. He recently joined Princeton's Board of Trustees.
notes: Four-time Forbes Midas List member. Best route is via Emergence Capital (Pier 5, San Francisco). Veeva board chair since 2008 per fintool profile.

name: John Pigott
current_role: Director, PACCAR Inc (since 2009); Partner, Beta Business Ventures LLC
profile: John M. Pigott is a member of the Pigott family that controls truck maker PACCAR (Kenworth, Peterbilt, DAF) and has sat on PACCAR's board since April 2009; his ~3.4M PACCAR shares underpin his wealth. He is a partner at Beta Business Ventures (formerly Beta Capital Group) and a director of ChemChamp North America.
interesting_fact: He is the brother of PACCAR Executive Chairman Mark Pigott; PACCAR cited his manufacturing and financial-services experience when naming him to the board in 2008.
notes: Low public profile; facts mostly from MarketScreener insider profile (Stanford undergrad, UCLA MBA, age ~62): https://www.marketscreener.com/insider/JOHN-PIGOTT-A0PHNK/. PACCAR press release page returned 403 to direct fetch; content seen via search snippet only. Best route is via PACCAR corporate office.

name: Richard Todd Schwartz
current_role: Chief Executive Officer and Director, Rush Street Interactive (NYSE: RSI)
profile: Lawyer-turned-iGaming executive who co-founded Rush Street Interactive (BetRivers online casino and sportsbook) in 2012 with Neil Bluhm and Greg Carlin. He served as president and was promoted to CEO in August 2021; his RSI stake underpins his wealth. Previously he built the online gaming business at WMS Industries.
interesting_fact: Before RSI he founded and led WMS Industries' interactive business, which in 2010 launched the award-winning UK-facing online casino Jackpot Party.
deep_cut_fact: He started at WMS Gaming as Intellectual Property Counsel before moving into corporate development and online gaming; earlier he was VP of Technology Development & Legal Affairs at Telecom Italia Lab USA in San Francisco. Berkeley AB, UC Hastings JD.

public_contacts.value: lisa@lisajohnsoncommunications.com (Lisa Johnson Communications, RSI media contact)

notes: CEO title confirmed on RSI About page (Nov 2026). Deep-cut details (WMS IP counsel, Telecom Italia Lab) come from search snippets of Gambling Insider profile (page 403 to direct fetch) - verify before use. Milken page fetch did not render bio; WMS/Jackpot Party fact seen in search snippet.

name: W Craig Jelinek
profile: Career retailer who joined Costco in 1984 as a warehouse manager, rose through operations to EVP merchandising (2004) and president (2010), and succeeded founder Jim Sinegal as CEO in 2012. He stepped down as CEO at the end of 2023 (succeeded by Ron Vachris) and continues on Costco's board; his Costco shares underpin his wealth.
interesting_fact: He started at Costco as a warehouse manager in 1984 and ran the company as CEO for 12 years; in 2019 he received the Committee for Economic Development's Peter G. Peterson Business Statesmanship Award.
deep_cut_fact: Before Costco he cut his teeth at discount chain FedMart, becoming an operations manager in Los Angeles, then moved to Lucky Stores in 1981; he is an Antelope Valley High School (1970) and San Diego State (1975) graduate.
notes: After CEO handover he remained an advisor until April 2024 and still serves on Costco's board (per Wikipedia). No personal channels found; route via Costco corporate (Issaquah, WA).

name: Malvinder Singh
current_role: No current listed corporate role (former promoter of Ranbaxy and Fortis Healthcare)
profile: Malvinder Mohan Singh, with his brother Shivinder, controlled drugmaker Ranbaxy and hospital chain Fortis Healthcare. They sold their majority Ranbaxy stake to Daiichi Sankyo in 2008 and resigned as Fortis directors in Feb 2018; IHH later took control of Fortis. Since then he has been embroiled in prolonged litigation.
interesting_fact: The Singh brothers sold control of Ranbaxy, then India's largest drugmaker, to Japan's Daiichi Sankyo in 2008.
notes: Unsuitable outreach target: subject of Daiichi arbitration award, Supreme Court contempt ruling, ED/fraud cases (see https://www.bloombergquint.com/business/2018/02/08/singh-brothers-resign-as-fortis-directors). Wealth figure (Hurun India 2015-17) is stale. No recent 2025-26 status confirmed; alive status not verified in this task.

name: Bindu PNC Menon
profile: Listed by Hurun India (2018-19) with wealth from PNC Investments, the Dubai vehicle PNC Menon set up in 2011 to bring the Sobha brand to the UAE (Sobha Hartland, District One). Wikipedia's P. N. C. Menon entry names a daughter Bindu, but no source found describes her role in any Menon company.
notes: Appears to be a Menon family member holding a share of the Sobha/PNC Investments fortune; no public role, interviews or channels found. Any approach would go via Sobha Group / Sobha Realty (now chaired by Ravi Menon). Source on PNC Investments: https://www.arabianbusiness.com/gcc/pnc-menon-built-last-497572

name: Luan Lin
current_role: General Manager & Director, Kuang-Chi Technologies Co., Ltd. (光启技术), since Dec 2022
profile: Duke-trained (PhD 2010) metamaterials scientist and one of the five Duke/Oxford PhDs who returned with Liu Ruopeng in 2010 to found the Kuang-Chi Institute of Advanced Technology in Shenzhen, forerunner of listed Kuang-Chi Technologies. He has been vice president of the institute since 2010, previously led KuangChi Science, and now runs Kuang-Chi Technologies as GM.
interesting_fact: He was part of the Duke student circle around Liu Ruopeng, whose team published the first broadband metamaterial 'invisibility cloak' paper in Science before returning to China to found Kuang-Chi.
deep_cut_fact: He served as a non-executive director of Martin Aircraft Company, the New Zealand jetpack maker backed by Kuang-Chi, and sits on the board of Kuang-Chi Martin Jetpack; his degrees are from Shandong University (2001), Peking University (2004) and Duke (2010).
notes: Low personal profile; route via Kuang-Chi Technologies (Shenzhen, A-share listed). Career dates from MarketScreener/Zonebourse insider profile, which has some inconsistencies.

name: Jia Haibo
current_role: CTO & non-independent director, Yangling Metron New Material Co. (300861.SZ)
profile: Jia Haibo (贾海波) is a co-founder-era executive and major shareholder (~3-5%) of Yangling Metron New Material, a Shaanxi maker of electroplated diamond wire used to slice silicon wafers for solar and semiconductors. He served as the company's CEO from 2015 to 2021 before moving to chief technology officer.
interesting_fact: Metron's diamond wire is a key consumable for cutting photovoltaic silicon, tying his fortune directly to China's solar manufacturing boom.
notes: Roles per Yahoo Finance / MarketScreener insider profile (https://uk.marketscreener.com/insider/HAI-BO-JIA-A258UD/experience/). Chairman is Liu Haiying (elected Nov 2024). A share-transfer agreement involving Zhang Yingjiu and Jia Haibo was reported; stake may have changed. Route via company board secretary.

name: Xu Xiaojie
profile: Xu Xiaojie (徐小捷) was named in Phoenix Healthcare Group's 2013 HKEX prospectus as holding, together with Xu Jie, all of Beijing Wantong, which indirectly controlled Yanhua Phoenix, sponsor of the Yanhua hospital group; Hurun listed the wealth jointly with Xu Jie (2014-15). Phoenix Healthcare (1515.HK) is now China Resources Medical.
notes: Only source found is the HKEX prospectus (https://www.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2013/1118/01515_1775038/C119.pdf). No current role or public channels found; wealth figure is from 2014-15 and stale.

name: Bian Cheng
current_role: Chairman, Keda Industrial Group (科达制造, 600499.SH), since Aug 2012; president of Foshan Enterprise Confederation
profile: Bian Cheng (边程, b. 1964, MBA, senior economist) joined Foshan-based Keda in 1998, served as director and general manager until 2012 and has chaired it since. Keda makes ceramic-tile machinery, builds tile/building-material plants overseas (notably Africa) and holds a strategic stake in lithium-salt producer Lanke Lithium, plus lithium-battery materials and smart-energy units.
interesting_fact: Keda's bet a decade ago on Lanke Lithium (Qinghai salt-lake lithium) and overseas tile plants is what Bian credits for its current results; Keda ranks 3rd in Foshan for tech innovation in the 2026 survey.
deep_cut_fact: At Foshan's 2026 entrepreneurs' day he told bosses their job is three things - find the right road, build the right team, split the money well - adding: 'Our boss mentality is the enemy of our future development' (我们老板的老板意识就是我们未来发展的敌人).
notes: Energy angle: lithium salt (Lanke Lithium) and battery anode materials. Board secretary is Peng Qi (彭琦) per 10jqka. Resume from 10jqka company page.

name: Zhao Make
current_role: Chairman & General Manager, Wuhan P&S Information Technology (力源信息, 300184.SZ)
profile: Zhao Make (赵马克, b. 1969), an Arizona State University electrical-engineering master's graduate, has been chairman and GM of Wuhan P&S since Nov 2003 and is its controlling shareholder (~11%). P&S is a leading Chinese distributor of electronic components (MCUs, power management, memory) that also designs its own chips and smart-grid products; it listed on ChiNext in 2011.
interesting_fact: He also runs the group's in-house chip unit, Wuhan Xinyuan Semiconductor (芯源半导体), as executive director and GM since 2018.
deep_cut_fact: Since January 2022 he has been vice-chairman of the Electronic Components Application & Supply Chain branch (ECAS) of the China Information Industry Trade Association.
notes: US citizen since 2004 with Chinese permanent residency (per company resume). Board secretary Wang Xiaodong (王晓东).

name: Shao Zehua
current_role: Chairman & General Manager, Chengdu Qinchuan IoT Technology (秦川物联, 688528.SH)
profile: Shao Zehua (邵泽华, b. 1967) built Chengdu Qinchuan from a gas-meter maker into a STAR-Market-listed IoT company; he ran its predecessor Qinchuan Co. from 2001/2005 and has been chairman and GM since 2017, holding ~101M shares. Products include IoT smart gas meters, sensors, industrial gas meters and smart water meters for utilities.
interesting_fact: Besides being chairman he is listed as one of the company's core technical personnel, and the firm describes its mission as theoretical and standards research on IoT and smart cities.
deep_cut_fact: Before Qinchuan he ran Chengdu Antai Industrial as executive director and GM (1997-2016); since 2021 he has also headed Chengdu Jiuguan Smart Energy Technology (成都九观智慧能源科技).
notes: Energy/utility angle: smart gas metering and a smart-energy affiliate. Board secretary/CFO Li Ting (李婷).

name: Jiang Xiewu
current_role: Director and Vice President (aquatic seedlings & aquaculture), Guangdong Haid Group (海大集团, 002311.SZ)
profile: Jiang Xiewu (江谢武, b. 1968) is a long-time senior executive of Haid Group, one of China's largest animal-feed and aquafeed companies. He joined in 2004, was a director 2007-2016 and again from 2026, and has been VP since 2010 (with a 2016-19 gap) running aquatic seedling and aquaculture businesses and heading Haid's Hinter (海因特) unit.
interesting_fact: He is vice-president of the China Fisheries Association and executive president of its aquatic-seedling branch, and was named among Guangdong's first batch of 'rural craftsman' professionals (senior title).
deep_cut_fact: He graduated in 1992 from Huazhong Agricultural University's fisheries college in special aquaculture - the same year and programme as Haid founder-chairman Xue Hua; he is also honorary president of the Weifang Fisheries Association.
notes: Direct shareholding is small (~50k shares) per 10jqka; Hurun wealth presumably via indirect holdings. Haid board secretary: Huang Zhijian (黄志健).

name: Yang Baotian
current_role: Controlling shareholder / actual controller (with Yang Cheng) of Red Phase Inc. (红相股份, 300427.SZ)
profile: Yang Baotian (杨保田) is the largest shareholder (~11.8%) and co-actual controller, with Yang Cheng, of Xiamen-based Red Phase, a maker of power-grid testing and monitoring equipment that has expanded into transformers, new-energy project development and special communications electronics. He reduced his stake via block trade in 2021.
interesting_fact: Red Phase operates an Australian subsidiary, Red Phase Instruments Australia, and in 2017 bought Wolong Electric's Yinchuan transformer business and Hefei Xingbo Communication.
notes: Holds no listed executive post; chairman is Yang Li (杨力). Company previously traded as *ST红相. Grid-equipment/solar angle relevant to energy podcast. Board secretary Fang Yuyang (方育阳).

name: Chen Hankang
current_role: Former actual controller of Zhejiang Kangsheng Co. (康盛股份, 002418.SZ); no current listed executive role found
profile: Chen Hankang (陈汉康, b. 1961), from Chun'an county, Zhejiang, was the actual controller of Kangsheng, a Chun'an-based maker of refrigeration tubing and parts for appliances that later moved into new-energy commercial vehicles and liquid-cooling products. He held ~7.5% directly in 2022 alongside his vehicle Zhejiang Runcheng Holding; control of Kangsheng has since passed to other holders.
interesting_fact: Kangsheng, registered in Chun'an's Pingshan industrial park near Qiandao Lake, became a supplier of refrigerant pipelines for fridges and air-conditioners before diversifying into EV commercial vehicles.
notes: Current controlling shareholders of Kangsheng are other entities (Changzhou Xingruo etc.); 2019-21 filings show pledged-share litigation and court-ordered share disposals (https://disc.static.szse.cn/disc/disk02/finalpage/2019-09-18/391054ec-c700-424c-881b-c07aa748f2d1.PDF). Hurun wealth (2015-17) shared with Zhou Zhen is stale; poor outreach target.

name: Gao Zhijiang
current_role: Co-founder and co-actual controller (29.1%) of Anhui Chaoyue Environmental Protection Technology (超越科技, 301049.SZ)
profile: Gao Zhijiang (高志江) co-founded Chuzhou Chaoyue Xinxing Waste Disposal in July 2009 with Li Guangrong, each putting in RMB 1.5M of its RMB 3M registered capital. The firm, now Anhui Chaoyue (listed on ChiNext), incinerates, landfills and recycles industrial hazardous waste and dismantles e-waste, and has added vehicle dismantling and lithium-battery recycling.
interesting_fact: Chaoyue started in 2009 with just RMB 3 million of registered capital in Chuzhou, Anhui, and grew into a listed hazardous-waste and e-waste processor now also in lithium-battery recycling.
notes: Not listed as chairman; chairman is co-founder Li Guangrong (李光荣). Board secretary/CFO Fan Min (范敏). Low personal profile.

name: Wang Laixing
current_role: Chairman and actual controller, Xianheng International Science & Technology (咸亨国际, 605056.SH)
profile: Wang Laixing (王来兴, b. 1956), a senior economist who rose through Shaoxing's supply-and-marketing cooperative system, built Xianheng into a Hangzhou-based MRO supplier of tools and instruments, mainly to power-grid, energy, transport and emergency customers. He has run the business since 2001 and been chairman since 2017, controlling ~20%.
interesting_fact: Xianheng is a one-stop MRO (tools and test instruments) supplier whose core customers are China's power grid and energy sector.
deep_cut_fact: He began as deputy head of the Jianhu supply-and-marketing co-op in Shaoxing county and studied business management by correspondence at Zhejiang Supply & Marketing Technical School; since 2014 he has sat on a national electrical-instrument standardization subcommittee.
notes: Strong fit for energy/grid angle. Previously named a Shaoxing model worker and outstanding entrepreneur. Board secretary Ye Xingbo (叶兴波).
